XTulator 8086/8088 CPU core by Mike Chambers
Vendored from https://github.com/mikechambers84/XTulator (2026-08-01).

The upstream source headers license this code under GNU GPL version 2 or,
at the user's option, any later version. Appletini One is distributed under
GNU GPL version 3, so this copy is used under the "or later" provision.

Imported files: cpu.c, cpu.h, cpuconf.h.

Appletini changes are deliberately small and visible in those files:

* select the CPU_8086 instruction set by default (the AD8088 contains an
  8088); a build may define CPU_V20 or another profile on the command line,
* remove XTulator's PC/PIC and logging dependencies,
* provide the local inline macro,
* add an opaque machine-model context pointer to CPU_t,
* add io_pending to CPU_t: a port callback sets it when the transfer cannot
  complete yet, and every I/O instruction then restores IP and returns from
  cpu_exec before it changes any register or memory, and
* make INSB/INSW step DI only and OUTSB/OUTSW step SI only, as the 80186 and
  V30 define them (these handlers are compiled out under CPU_8086).

The complete GNU GPL version 3 license for this combined work is in the
repository root LICENSE file. The original copyright and GPL notice remain
at the top of every imported source file.
